description: This file defines custom error classes for various error conditions, all extending a base TaggedError class from the 'effect' module. It serves as a centralized module for error handling in the application.

classes.name: NotFoundError
classes.description: Error thrown when a resource is not found.

classes.name: NotOwnerError
classes.description: Error thrown when a user attempts to access or modify a resource they don't own.

classes.name: R2StorageError
classes.description: Error thrown when a storage operation fails.

classes.name: ForbiddenError
classes.description: Error thrown when a user attempts to access a resource they don't have permission to.

classes.name: PayloadTooLargeError
classes.description: Error thrown when a payload is too large.

classes.name: ServiceUnavailableError
classes.description: Error thrown when a service is unavailable.

classes.name: InternalServerError
classes.description: Error thrown when an internal server error occurs.

classes.name: BadRequestError
classes.description: Error thrown when a bad request is made.
